beat: Chotu explains guilt; Dhika reassures, restores conversation and gives painting clothes

lines.original: Chotu: no no... no didi...it was me.... I couldn't control.... he felt embarrassed.....
lines.local: Chotu sharminda hokar: Nahi, nahi didi... mujhse hi... main khud ko control nahi kar paaya.

lines.original: Dhika: hey... its really fine dear.... nothing wrong happened......
lines.local: Dhika: Arre dear, sach mein koi baat nahi. Kuch galat nahi hua.

lines.original: Chotu: no didi... I have great respect and love for you..... how could I do it.... a tear from his eyes fell on her hands......
lines.local: Chotu: Nahi didi, main aapki bahut respect karta hoon aur aapse bahut pyaar karta hoon. Main aisa kaise kar sakta hoon? Uski aankh ka aansu Dhika ke haath par gira.

lines.original: Dhika: oohhh Chotu... nothing happened... see... I am still the same... I still love you the same... she wiped his tears and held his chin and smiled at him.....
lines.local: Dhika: Ooh Chotu, dekho, main pehle jaisi hi hoon; tumse pehle jitna pyaar karti thi utna hi karti hoon. Usne aansu ponchhe, chin uthakar muskuraayi.

lines.original: Chotu became a bit calm and gave a faint smile....
lines.local: Chotu thoda shaant hua aur halki smile di.

lines.original: Dhika: is that why you didn't talk or come to see me for a week.. she gave him a playful angry look.....
lines.local: Dhika playful gusse mein: Isi liye poore ek hafte se mujhse baat nahi ki aur milne nahi aaye?

lines.original: Chotu: snorting a little laugh.. jikkk.... sorry didi.... I felt vey bad....
lines.local: Chotu halki hansi ke saath: Sorry didi... mujhe bahut bura lag raha tha.

lines.original: Dhika: Chotu dear.... nothing wrong... if anything, it was my mistake.....
lines.local: Dhika: Chotu dear, koi baat nahi. Agar kuch hai bhi, toh galti meri thi.

lines.original: Chotu: hmmm no.....
lines.local: Chotu: Hmmm... nahi.

lines.original: Dhika: lets drop it then.... lets not think about it okay... smile now.....I want you to smile now.... else I won't pay for the goods.... she said standing up
lines.local: Dhika: Chalo phir is baat ko chhodte hain. Ab mat socho, theek hai? Ab smile karo, warna samaan ke paise nahi dungi! Woh khadi ho gayi.

lines.original: Chotu smiled and even laughed a bit at seeing Dhika standing there like a stubburn child... saying she won't pay if he won't do what she says.....
lines.local: Use ziddi bacchi ki tarah khade hokar paise rokne ki dhamki dete dekh Chotu muskuraaya aur thoda hans bhi diya.

lines.original: Chotu noticed she was looking cute like a rabbit today.. she was wearing a cute shorts and a black colored full hand shirt.... had a pony tail with a little loose hairs on the front.....
lines.local: Chotu ne notice kiya ki aaj Dhika rabbit jaisi cute lag rahi thi: shorts, kaale rang ki full-sleeve shirt, ponytail aur saamne halka khula baal.

lines.original: Dhika: thats good now... she leaned and gave him a kiss on forehead.....
lines.local: Dhika: Ab theek hai! Woh jhukkar uske maathe par kiss karti hai.

lines.original: Suddenly remembering something.... she ran into her bed room... Chotu saw where she was running... she was even hopping like a rabbit and went into her bedroom... he smiled looking at her....
lines.local: Achanak kuch yaad aane par woh bedroom ki taraf daudi. Chotu ne use rabbit ki tarah uchhalte bedroom jaate dekha aur muskuraaya.

lines.original: Dhika: see... I bought something for you...... she handed him a parcel.....
lines.local: Dhika: Dekho, tumhare liye kuch khareeda hai! Usne parcel thamaaya.

lines.original: Chotu: what is it didi... he asked getting it from her....
lines.local: Chotu: Kya hai didi? Usne parcel liya.

lines.original: Inside the bag... he found a bunch of dresses.... two cotton shorts.... two vests, which unlike his own, had flowers printed on them and another full hand T shirt....
lines.local: Bag mein bahut se kapde the: do cotton shorts, do flower-print vests jo uski apni vest se alag the, aur ek full-sleeve T-shirt.

lines.original: Dhika: I bought these shorts and vests... so that you can wear them when you come here to help me paint... and you don't have to spoil your current dresses.....
lines.local: Dhika: Yeh shorts aur vests isliye liye hain ki yahan painting mein madad karte waqt pehen sako aur apne kapde kharaab na karo.

lines.original: Chotu: thank you didi.... and this T shirt....
lines.local: Chotu: Thank you didi. Aur yeh T-shirt?

lines.original: Dhika: oh.. that I saw while buying these and thought you would look cute on it... so that is a gift.....
lines.local: Dhika: Inhe khareedte hue woh dikhi aur laga tum usmein cute lagoge; isliye yeh tumhara gift hai.

lines.original: Chotu: feeling happy... thank you very much didi.... he stood up and gave her a hug...
lines.local: Chotu bahut khush hua: Bahut-bahut thank you didi! Woh khada hua aur Dhika ko hug kiya.

lines.original: Dhika went in and kept the things from the floor in the kitchen top... and returned with money and a glass of juice for chotu....
lines.local: Dhika farsh se samaan uthakar kitchen counter par rakh aayi; phir paise aur Chotu ke liye juice lekar lauti.

lines.original: They spoke about a few things for a while... she asked him about his family and he asked for John and Pappu... and everything......
lines.local: Kuch der dono ne ghar-parivaar ki baat ki. Dhika ne uske family ke baare mein poochha; Chotu ne John aur Pappu ke baare mein.

lines.original: It was getting late and Chotu decided to leave...
lines.local: Der hone lagi thi, toh Chotu ne jaane ka faisla kiya.

lines.original: When Chotu stood up.... about to say he will leave..... she grabbed his arm and pulled him down into the sofa.....
lines.local: Woh uthkar jaane ko kehne hi waala tha ki Dhika ne uski baah pakadkar wapas sofa par kheench liya.

lines.original: Dhika: dear.... promise me something before you go... should not ever cry like you did today.....
lines.local: Dhika: Dear, jaane se pehle promise karo: aaj jaise dobara kabhi mat rona.

lines.original: Chotu: hmmmm...... okay didi.. I won't...
lines.local: Chotu: Hmm... theek hai didi, nahi rounga.

lines.original: Dhika: these are not things that should make you cry... when you didn't do any wrong at all...
lines.local: Dhika: Aisi baat par rona nahi chahiye jab tumne kuch galat kiya hi nahi.

lines.original: Chotu: looking sweetly at her.... I won't didi.. promise.....
lines.local: Chotu pyaar se dekhkar: Nahi rounga didi, promise.
